description.to: The LeftBlock README text and Mermaid shift-left diagram are implemented and verified at local source checkpoint e3934c90bedec7fbaa137f62c6e0503ba708ed9b. The explanation distinguishes early interception from detection after local history or downstream copies already contain material, including actual hook timing, staged-diff limits, misses, bypasses, overrides, receipt trust boundaries and layered defenses.
